grid.expression: SELECT TO_CHAR(REFERENCIA,'MM/YYYY') AS PERIODO, CODREC, LAST_DAY(REFERENCIA) AS AP_FINAL, LAST_DAY(TRUNC(REFERENCIA)) + 20 AS VENCIMENTO, NVL(ROUND(BASE,2),0) AS BASE, NVL(ROUND(ALIQUOTA,2),0) AS ALIQUOTA, NVL(ROUND(VALOR,2),0) AS VALOR, ' ' || NOME_IMP || ' NF ' || NUMNOTA || ' ' || PARCEIRO AS OBS, NUMNOTA, CODNAT, DESCRNAT FROM (SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.DTENTSAI AS REFERENCIA, CAB.CODPARC, PAR.NOMEPARC AS PARCEIRO, (CASE WHEN IMN.TIPOIMPOSTO = 4 THEN 'ISS' WHEN IMN.TIPOIMPOSTO = 5 THEN 'INSS' WHEN IMN.TIPOIMPOSTO = 6 THEN 'PIS' WHEN IMN.TIPOIMPOSTO = 7 THEN 'COFINS' WHEN IMN.TIPOIMPOSTO = 8 THEN 'IRF' WHEN IMN.TIPOIMPOSTO = 0 THEN 'CSRF' END) AS NOME_IMP, SUM(ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC) AS VLRCTB, CAB.VLRNOTA, IMC.CODREC, SUM(IMN.BASE) AS BASE, SUM(IMN.ALIQUOTA) AS ALIQUOTA, SUM(IMN.VALOR) AS VALOR, CAB.CODNAT, (SELECT DISTINCT N.DESCRNAT FROM TGFNAT N WHERE N.CODNAT = CAB.CODNAT) AS DESCRNAT FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFTOP OPE ON (CAB.CODTIPOPER = OPE.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = OPE.DHALTER) INNER JOIN TGFIMN IMN ON (CAB.NUNOTA = IMN.NUNOTA AND ITE.NUNOTA = IMN.NUNOTA AND ITE.SEQUENCIA = IMN.SEQUENCIA) INNER JOIN TGFIMC IMC ON IMN.CODIMP = IMC.CODIMP WHERE OPE.ATUALLIVISS = 'E' AND CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND CAB.CODEMP <> 501 AND CAB.CODEMP = 1 AND CAB.DTENTSAI >= :P_DTENTSAI.INI AND CAB.DTENTSAI <= :P_DTENTSAI.FIN GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.CODPARC, PAR.NOMEPARC, CAB.VLRNOTA, IMN.TIPOIMPOSTO, IMC.CODREC, CAB.CODNAT ORDER BY 2, 3) V ORDER BY 2
